UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Registered Blush member profile stored after Google Sign-In.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the document ID.

username.description: Unique handle for Blush welcome card (3-30 characters, alphanumeric/underscore/dot).

pinkStyle.description: Preferred pink visual accent style selected during registration.

bio.description: Optional short bio or welcome greeting (0-160 characters).

photoUrl.description: Optional Google profile photo URL (up to 500 characters).

loginCount.description: Total number of authenticated Firebase login sessions recorded for this user.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent authenticated login (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when registration was completed (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest profile update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LoginLog.title: LoginLog
LoginLog.description: Immutable login session record persisted to Firestore on Firebase authentication.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID matching the parent user document.

provider.description: Firebase Auth identity provider used for login.

email.description: Authenticated user email at login time.

deviceLabel.description: Readable device and app label for the login session.

loginAt.description: Server timestamp when the login occurred (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Private owner-only user registration profile and welcome metadata.

/users/{userId}/loginLogs/{logId}.description: Owner-only subcollection tracking authenticated Firebase login sessions.
